title: Energy Data Analyst
text: Energy Data Analyst at Alinta Energy (Perth, CBD, Inner & Western Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). A bit about us: Alinta Energy supplies natural gas and electricity to 800,000 homes and businesses throughout Australia. Our mission of 'keeping it fair' is underpinned by its values of affordability, simplicity, efficiency, and environmental friendliness. With a focus on providing exceptional customer service, and reducing energy expenses, Alinta Energy continues to grow. A bit about the role: An exciting opportunity has become available for an Energy Data Analyst to join our Commercial Team in Perth. The team supports our Retail Markets business pillar through the analysis of large and varied datasets in order to provide commercial insight related to our customer base and their behaviour. As part of the role you will be required to source, validate, analyse and forecast complex data sets to a high degree of accuracy, in a robust and efficient manner. Duties and responsibilities will include but are not limited to the following: Use a variety of data mining/data analysis methods, using a variety of data tools, building and implementing models, using/creating algorithms and creating/running simulations Drive customer results through data-based insights and predictions. Provide proactive analytical support for customer opportunities around market and customer behaviour, volumes, product development, and pricing Work with a wide range of stakeholders and functional teams to discover solutions and improve business outcomes Support the Commercial Manager in articulating the impact of analysis Manipulate the structure of data as required to interface with mathematical and reporting applications Data validation and testing to ensure quality of data products Document data requirements and coordinate with stakeholders to ensure viable outcomes Develop and document business rules around data to ensure consistent and clear reporting across numerous stakeholder groups Develop and maintain systems and tools to effectively support continued improvement initiatives Provide post-delivery support to business and internal stakeholders Develop and maintain documentation of processes and controls Provide appropriate input into retail transformation projects to ensure that operational implications are considered and commercial processes and controls are maintained What we're looking for: Relevant tertiary qualification in commerce, economics, mathematics or other relevant numeric discipline Hands on experience in SQL, Excel and analytics tools (e.g. R, Python, SAS) Experience with data visualisation tools e.g. Tableau, PowerBI Experience with customer base segmentation and behaviour models Demonstrated analytical and critical thinking abilities combined with a strong attention to detail, with understanding of predicative and statistical modelling techniques such as regression, segmentation and clustering Demonstrated willingness and ability to learn new skills Highly developed ability to work in a team environment and effectively prioritise work load What's in it for you? It's a really exciting time to join Alinta, we are growing fast and need people who want to grow with us. This role will offer you a foot in the door to a meritocratic culture that could lead down various career paths building an extremely bright future for yourself! Work with people that know success first hand, that share your passion. The energy is infectious as new growth lands and ideas flow. There are many new directions we are taking and it's exciting. Choose this path and know your career will accelerate at Alinta Energy. Let spread the positive energy together… Click "APPLY" to submit your application. Closing Date: Monday 30 April 2018
